correctness.rationale: PASS. Extinction indicators E_A,E_B satisfy Cov(1-E_A,1-E_B)=q_u-q_a q_b with q_s=binom(r,s)/binom(n,s). For nested sets q_u(1-q_min)>=0. For incomparable sets, r between max(a,b) and u-1 gives strict negativity; for r>=u, ratio H_{r+1}/H_r=((r+1-a)(r+1-b))/((r+1)(r+1-u)), whose deviation from one is (ab-c(r+1))/positive denominator. Hence H_r unimodal and H_n=1, while penultimate covariance=(nc-ab)/n^2; deduces negative-only versus at most one negative-to-positive switch, with equality at most one intermediate stage. Independent exact rational binomial checks across all valid cardinalities for n<=10 and removed stages reproduced the signs; finite check is not the general proof.
